# Take a pic

> Photo booth rental in New York featuring an AI robot photographer and a drone that supports a 360° camera. Weddings, corporate events and open-space parties.

## Booths
- [Takeapic AI Robot](https://takeabic.biz/takeapic): robot photographer that roams the event, AI photo styles, instant prints. Priced by the hour.
- [Magic Mirror](https://takeabic.biz/magic-mirror): full-length interactive mirror booth with prints. Priced by print package.
- [Magazine Photo Booth](https://takeabic.biz/magazine-photo-booth): life-size back-lit magazine cover with red carpet. Flat event packages.
- [360 Photo Booth](https://takeabic.biz/360-photo-booth): slow-motion 360° video, optional drone. Priced by the hour.
- Add-ons: GIFs & Boomerangs, Custom Overlay, Props Upgrade, Premium Backdrop, Travel Fee.
